gloss: in turn; one after another; in order

definitions.gloss: in turn; one after another; in order; sequentially
definitions.explanation: Doing something in a fixed order, with each person or thing taking their turn one at a time.

examples.japanese: {順々|じゅんじゅん}に{並|なら}んでください。
{生徒|せいと}たちが{順々|じゅんじゅん}に{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The students presented one after another.

examples.japanese: {申込|もうしこ}みを{受|う}け{付|つ}けた{順|じゅん}に、{順々|じゅんじゅん}にご{案内|あんない}いたします。
examples.english: We will serve you in turn, in the order applications were received.

notes:
Formed by reduplication of {順|じゅん} (order, turn) plus the particle に. The reduplication emphasizes the sequential, one-by-one nature of the process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up in order
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に{回|まわ}す: to pass around in turn
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に{進|すす}む: to proceed in order
- {順々|じゅんじゅん}に{呼|よ}ぶ: to call one by one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {順番|じゅんばん}に: in order — very similar; {順々|じゅんじゅん}に emphasizes the one-after-another rhythm more
- {次々|つぎつぎ}に: one after another — implies rapid succession, possibly without a fixed order; {順々|じゅんじゅん}に implies a specific sequence
- {交代|こうたい}で: taking turns — implies rotation; {順々|じゅんじゅん}に implies a fixed sequence
